## Description

Optimizes institutional order execution by minimizing worst-case expected execution slippage over a Wasserstein ambiguity set of multivariate Hawkes point process jump arrival parameters.

## Where it may fit

Large institutional block trades, flash crash execution, liquidity shock environments.

## Vehicles

Agency Execution Desks, Algorithmic Execution Brokers, Institutional Asset Managers.

## Required data

Millisecond limit order book level 2/3 message streams, trade timestamps, historical volume curves.

## Caveats

Minimax robust optimization reformulations require efficient conic programming solvers.
